info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Manage Consumer Investments API
info.description: The Manage Consumer Investments API allows users to update and modify existing investment options for individual consumers. This endpoint is specifically designed for financial service providers and investment managers who need to adjust key details such as contribution amounts, investment strategies, or asset allocations. With flexible PATCH operations, developers can easily implement changes based on dynamic consumer needs or market conditions. Typical consumers of this API include banking applications and investment platforms seeking to enhance user engagement and financial outcomes.

patch.description: This endpoint allows you to update the details of a specific consumer investment resource identified by the unique ID. Ensure to provide the necessary data in the request body to successfully modify the investment details.

requestBody.description: This request body contains the necessary data to update the consumer investment details for the specified resource ID. Please ensure that all required fields are included as specified in the schema.
